topics.name: M&A and Deals
topics.query: mergers acquisitions deal announced OR acquisition completed
topics.focus: Deal announcements, completions, and terminations. Prioritise transactions with disclosed values, cross-border deals, and anything involving technology assets or carve-outs.

topics.name: Deal Tech and Diligence
topics.query: technology due diligence OR IT integration merger OR carve-out separation
topics.focus: Anything about the technology dimension of transactions — IT diligence, systems integration, TSAs, separation, cloud migration in deal context.

topics.name: Consulting Research
topics.query: McKinsey OR Bain OR BCG OR Deloitte OR EY report study findings
topics.focus: New research, reports, and surveys published by major consulting firms. Skip firm PR, partner hires, and award announcements — only substantive research.

topics.name: AI Industry
topics.query: artificial intelligence enterprise adoption OR AI model release
topics.focus: Model releases, enterprise AI deployment, funding rounds, and capability shifts. Skip speculative think-pieces and opinion columns.

topics.name: AI Policy and Regulation
topics.query: AI regulation policy act legislation government
topics.focus: Regulatory developments across jurisdictions. Note which country or bloc, and what stage the measure is at — proposed, passed, in force.
